The reported NAV is ex-dividend an interim dividend of 0.70 pence per Ordinary share payable in relation to the half year ended 31 March 2026 which will be paid on 31 July 2026 to those shareholders on the Company’s register on 26 June 2026. The unaudited cum-dividend NAV was 32.61 pence per Ordinary share.
